description: This file defines the ModerationStateFilter class for Drupal's content moderation module, implementing a views filter for moderation states of entities, including methods for cache management, options retrieval, dependency handling, and query modification.

classes.name: ModerationStateFilter
classes.description: A Drupal views filter plugin for moderation states of content entities, allowing filtering based on workflow states and managing cache and dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with entity type manager, bundle info, and workflow storage services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the filter with services from the container.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags related to workflows for cache invalidation.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts related to workflows for cache invalidation.

methods.name: getValueOptions
methods.description: Retrieves available moderation states grouped by workflow labels for filter options.

methods.name: opSimple
methods.description: Modifies the query to filter entities based on selected moderation states and workflows.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies related to workflows.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Determines if the filter should be removed when certain dependencies are removed.

methods.name: getWorkflowIds
methods.description: Extracts workflow IDs from the filter's selected values.
